events.content:
Implemented the gallery transitions.

- Added a client navigation layer that wraps grid/detail route changes in the browser View Transition API, with rightward entry from the grid and leftward return from the detail page. Browsers without that API get a CSS slide fallback. See [ViewTransitions.tsx](/workspace/app/ViewTransitions.tsx:31).
- Matched each product thumbnail and detail hero with a per-product transition name so the image morphs between their sizes and positions. See [ProductGrid.tsx](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx:9) and [product/[slug]/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/%5Bslug%5D/page.tsx:40).
- Added a content reveal for loaded product details and made reduced-motion preferences disable route, reveal, and skeleton animations. See [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css:78).

I did not run tests or a build. `package.json` and the untracked `package-lock.json` also show separate workspace changes; I left them untouched.
